_doc: BM25 + metadata retrieval field weights and scoring constants

name_weight.doc: BM25 multiplier for function name field. High = name match >> body match.

summary_weight.doc: BM25 multiplier for T1 Haiku summary field (0 = disable).

callee_weight.doc: BM25 multiplier for callee names field.

signature_weight.doc: BM25 multiplier for function signature field.

body_weight.doc: BM25 multiplier for function body text (baseline).

symbol_boost.doc: Additive score boost when query token exactly matches a known function name.

chain_expand_k.doc: Extra result slots for call-chain expansion (callers/callees of top results).

large_fn_lines.doc: Functions above this line count get a div(log(lines)) size penalty.

rrf_k.doc: RRF constant k in score = 1/(k+rank). Lower = top ranks matter more.
